=<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <!-- 1. Auth credentials -->
    <param><value><string>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.db_name }}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.UID }}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.user_password }}</string></value></param>

    <!-- 2. Target model -->
    <param><value><string>mailing.mailing</string></value></param>

    <!-- 3. Method -->
    <param><value><string>create</string></value></param>

    <!-- 4. Values -->
    <param>
      <value>
        <array><data>
          <value>
            <struct>
              <!-- Basic fields -->
              <member>
                <name>name</name>
                <value><string>{{ $json.newsletter_name }}</string></value>
              </member>
              <member>
                <name>subject</name>
                <value><string>{{ $json.newsletter_subject }}</string></value>
              </member>
              
              <!-- Required model reference -->
              <member>
                <name>mailing_model_id</name>
                <value><int>660</int></value>
              </member>
              
              <!-- Campaign link (optional but safe) -->
              <member>
                <name>campaign_id</name>
                <value><int>{{ $json.campaign_id }}</int></value>
              </member>
              
              <!-- Sender -->
              <member>
                <name>email_from</name>
                <value><string>{{ $('Odoo XML creds').item.json.user_name }}</string></value>
              </member>

              <!-- Email format -->
              <member>
                <name>mailing_type</name>
                <value><string>mail</string></value>
              </member>
              <member>
                <name>state</name>
                <value><string>draft</string></value>
              </member>

              <!-- HTML content -->
              <member>
                <name>body_arch</name>
                <value><string><![CDATA[
                  {{ $('Build Newsletter HTML').item.json.html_body }}
                ]]></string></value>
              </member>
              <member>
                <name>body_html</name>
                <value><string><![CDATA[
                  {{ $('Build Newsletter HTML').item.json.html_body }}
                ]]></string></value>
              </member>
            </struct>
          </value>
        </data></array>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>

=<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <param><value><string>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.db_name }}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.UID }}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>{{ $('Full credentials').item.json.user_password }}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>mailing.mailing</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>write</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array><data>
          <!-- mailing_id from step 1 -->
          <value><array><data><value><int>{{ $json.mailing_id }}</int></value></data></array></value>
          <!-- updated fields -->
          <value>
            <struct>
              <member><name>body_html</name>
                <value><string><![CDATA[
                  {{ $('Build Newsletter HTML').item.json.html_body }}
                ]]></string></value>
              </member>
            </struct>
          </value>
        </data></array>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>
